name: M6.8 EARTHQUAKE
description: Shallow M6.8 quake, epicentre 1.2 km west of Meridian Tower.

edges.note: facade collapse across Main St (traffic cam)

reports.text: HELP!! ceiling came down in room 305, Grace is pinned under a desk and can't move her legs
Glass everywhere in the Meridian lobby, a few people have small cuts
Lobby windows blew out, minor cuts, we're mostly ok
people with small cuts in the lobby, need first aid kit
Meridian lobby — lots of broken glass, minor injuries
WEARABLE FALL ALERT: hard impact detected, no movement for 4 min, heart rate 128
Strong smell of gas on Main St by the Meridian, hissing from a manhole

aftershock.text: Keep search teams out of the ring between sweeps; stage Engine 7 outside the zone

weakened_building.text: Restrict re-entry to {target} after evacuation; structural check before rescue teams go above floor 2

fire.text: Shut the Main St gas main valve (GAS-1) and stage a fire unit at Main & West

power_loss.text: Dispatch generator fuel to {target} before backup runs out

comms_loss.text: Pre-position mesh repeaters near {target}; push 'save battery' alert to residents

water_loss.text: Stage water tankers for Civic Hospital and fire units; notify ER of pressure drop

traffic_loss.text: Deploy manual traffic control at {target}; keep Central Ave clear for responders

compromise.text: Isolate {target} from the {vector} network and switch to manual control
